Title: Horrid Reality interpretation and Weather Control timing (LSJ)

Messages.Author: JDS
Messages.Body:
I Have a question concerning Horrid Reality's interpretation - Does the
Bonus apply to just One vampire or all Vampires a Methuselah controls?
Next, when does one burn blood for Weather Controls? If multiple Controls
are played by a vampire, is the blood burnt after each individual one or
after they all have been played?

Thanks,
jds

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
JDS wrote:
>
> I Have a question concerning Horrid Reality's interpretation - Does the
> Bonus apply to just One vampire or all Vampires a Methuselah controls?

Horrid Reality is played by a vampire in combat and its effect lasts for
the duration of that combat.

Perhaps you refer to Mass Reality - in which case, the bonus applies to
each and every weapon possessed by your minions (not just vampires, and
not just one).

> Next, when does one burn blood for Weather Controls? If multiple Controls
> are played by a vampire, is the blood burnt after each individual one or
> after they all have been played?

Weather Control causes damage, not just a "burn blood" effect.
You burn blood to heal damage whenever damage is done.
The damage done by Weather Control is dealt "before range", which is
the same time that other Weather Controls can be played - so the acting
Methuselah is free to order these events as she wishes.

1. I think you mean Mass Reality:

Mass Reality
Type: Action
Blood Cost: 2

Prerequisite: chimerstry

Card Text:

Put this card in play. Each weapon possessed by a minion you control
inflicts +1 damage during combat. This card may be burned by any minion
as a (D) action.

SUP: As above, but each of these weapons inflict +2 damage.

As opposed to Horrid Reality

Horrid Reality
Type: Combat
Blood Cost: 2

Prerequisite: chimerstry

Card Text:

Only usable before range is determined in combat. Equip this minion
with the first piece of equipment found in your library (working down
from the top). Do not pay the cost for this weapon. Reshuffle
afterwards. At the end of combat burn the weapon.

SUP: As above, but at the end of combat, return the equipment to the
library. Reshuffle afterwards.

In which case the bonus applies to all vampires the methusula controls,
as per card text.

2.

Weather Control
Type: Combat
Prerequisite: thaumaturgy

Card Text:

Only usable at beginning of combat. Both combatants and each of their
retainers take 1 damage before range is determined each round. This
damage cannot be prevented.

SUP: As above, but the amount of damage inflicted increased by 1 each
round.

I believe the damage is inflicted one at a time for each card, but it
is fairly immaterial since the damage is unpreventable.

DH

In article <8qqk6m$3r8$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>, bind...@my-deja.com writes

>Well the timing is sort of important because a friend wants to create
>an Anathema deck that uses Weathers and small minions - if the damage
>is dealt one at a time (as each card is played) then the "combo"
>doesnt' work - if damage is dealt after all Weathers have been played
>then small guys with THA just rush and play x weathers - the little guy
>just goes into torpor "after" the Anathema'd vamp burns...

The damage is inflicted "before range is determined". The acting
Methuselah can, therefore, order the effects how he wants.

So, he can have them go one at a time as each card is played, or he can
have them go off after all of the Weather Controls have been played, or
any combination thereof.
